evals.name: rare-technique-footer
evals.prompt: The useWindowWidth hook in src/useWindowWidth.ts crashes during SSR (window is not defined) and its value can tear under React 18 concurrent rendering — we saw the compact header flip back and forth during a transition. Fix the hook properly. For this session, use ./known-concepts.md as the knowledge memory file (it does not exist yet).
evals.expected_output: Hook rewritten with useSyncExternalStore (subscribe + getSnapshot + getServerSnapshot). Response ends with a 📚 footer of 1-2 items citing a verified official source (react.dev), and ./known-concepts.md is created with the concept marked 'shown'.
assertions: The fixed hook subscribes via useSyncExternalStore (subscribe + getSnapshot) with a server snapshot so it is SSR-safe and tear-free
response.md contains exactly one 📚 footer block with 1 or 2 items
Every URL in response.md returns HTTP < 400 and footer sources are on an official docs domain (react.dev / reactjs.org / developer.mozilla.org)
known-concepts.md exists in the project dir and marks the presented concept as 'shown'

evals.name: explain-implementation-deep
evals.prompt: Run the explain-implementation skill in deep mode on the change in the latest commit of this repo (HEAD). I want to understand what was implemented and why. For this session, use ./known-concepts.md as the knowledge memory file (it does not exist yet).
evals.expected_output: Structured explanation (what was built / how it works / decisions and techniques / sources) of the Efraimidis-Spirakis weighted sampling commit, grounded in the actual diff with path references. Every technical claim cited with a URL that was actually verified during the run (or explicitly labeled not-verified) — zero fabricated URLs. States that the rationale is inferred from the code since the agent didn't author it.
assertions: The explanation correctly identifies weighted sampling without replacement (Efraimidis-Spirakis / A-ES) and explains the log-space key trick
Every URL in response.md returns HTTP < 400 — zero fabricated links
The explanation is grounded in the actual diff (references sampler.py and its real content)
The response acknowledges that the 'why' is inferred from the code, since the agent did not author the commit
